assumptions.rangeMeaning: The minimum and maximum of two explicitly named model configurations; not a confidence interval, scientific uncertainty range or guaranteed bounds on actual emissions.
assumptions.hosting: Green hosting is an assumption, not a lookup. In SWD v4 it removes the modeled data-center operational component; network, device and embodied components remain.
assumptions.boundary: Attributional model of data-center, network and end-user-device operational and embodied emissions, using bytes as a proxy.
assumptions.interpretation: A modeled difference under hypothetical visits, not measured electricity or verified avoided emissions. It is not a marginal energy or carbon-saving measurement.
assumptions.exclusions: Does not measure real traffic, caching, deployment, optimization overhead, the application payload, or the net life-cycle effect of image replacements.

measurement.bytes: Exact file lengths, excluding ZIP overhead and generated documentation. outputBytes and primaryOutputBytes count only selected primary images. additionalVariantBytes counts smaller responsive files. allImageBytes is the actual combined image storage in this archive. savedBytes and savedPercent compare source files with primary outputs only; they are not total archive storage savings.
measurement.similarity: Encoded candidates use mean local luminance SSIM in non-overlapping 8 × 8 blocks across nine native-resolution patches up to 128 × 128 pixels, positioned at left/center/right by top/middle/bottom. Patches are not downsampled and can overlap on small images. The original is first resampled to the output dimensions. RGBA samples are composited on white. Retained originals receive 1 by file identity. This does not measure resolution loss against the full original and can miss color shifts or artifacts outside the patches. It is not a guarantee of perceptual equivalence, legibility, color fidelity or accessibility. Inspect the images yourself.
measurement.savings: Output file reduction only. Storage or transfer benefits require using these files instead of the originals. Cache behavior, repeat visits and encoding overhead are not measured.
measurement.responsive: Responsive variants are additional stored files. The browser chooses among srcset candidates using layout size, pixel density and browser behavior; it does not ordinarily download every variant for one image. Supplied sizes assume full viewport width up to the primary image width and must be adapted to the website layout. Actual candidate selection and transferred bytes are not measured. Original selections omit variants. Folder-relative input paths are recorded for mapping; exported filenames are flattened and deduplicated.
measurement.environment: Electricity, water consumption, avoided emissions and total environmental impact have not been measured. Traffic scenarios, if shown in the app, are hypothetical.
measurement.hashes: SHA-256 of each original input file and each exact exported output file.
